Legacy campaign

First Light (1882–1901)

One small coal plant. One hundred customers. Start a utility in 1882 and leave the next generation a company worth inheriting.

Explore the Legacy campaign↗ See what’s at stake ↓

The situation

Your starting point

First Light opens the Legacy campaign, a sequence of nine twenty-year terms running from 1882 to 2061. You begin with a small coal plant and a hundred customers in a fictional California utility.

Get electricity revenue to cover operating costs by the end of your fourth year, then prepare for growing demand. The company you build carries forward: later leaders inherit its equipment, customers and financial position.

The choices

What will you do?

  1. 01

    Make the first customers pay their way

    Set a price that supports operation without losing the small community you serve. Early cash has several jobs and little room for waste.

  2. 02

    Expand beyond the opening plant

    Watch demand growth and the arrival of a small hydro opportunity. Compare new construction with the coal bill you will otherwise keep paying.

  3. 03

    Leave something useful behind

    Think past your own term. The next generation takes over the company you actually built, including its debts and aging equipment.

Put your plan to the test

Start small, then see what nearly two centuries of decisions can grow from it.

Open the campaign setup to begin, or continue your existing company. Later generations inherit the choices you made before them.
